content:
The script failed to remove the layout cache elements from modified paragraphs in the HWPX document.
An AssertionError occurred because 'hp:linesegarray' elements were still present in modified paragraphs within section0.xml and section1.xml. The test script test_outputs.py confirmed that text modifications to budget and phases did not trigger the required removal of these child elements. This violates the requirement to delete all lineSegArray tags from every modified hp:p element to prevent rendering corruption.
